description: Two rules that no real terraform_data run can tell apart, because every one of its resources finishes in zero seconds. stage.alpha: three members, overlapping, and the node is busy from the FIRST start to the LAST finish — 10:00:00 to 10:02:02 is 122 seconds, not the 128 you get by adding them up and not the 120 the longest one took. stage.slow: the member that ran five minutes carries no identifier, so the node shows the one that ran ten seconds and does carry one — the identifier is taken from the longest member THAT HAS ONE, and nothing is enriched to produce a better answer.
